name: qz-agent-clusters
description: 15 independently installable QA capabilities across four clusters. Each plugin bundles one agent with its task-level skills — 67 skills in total.

plugins.name: qa-requirements-refinement
plugins.description: INVEST scoring, ambiguity detection and acceptance criteria authoring. Turns vague stories into testable ones before development starts.

plugins.name: qa-change-impact-analysis
plugins.description: Blast radius tracing, change risk scoring and minimum viable test scope. Answers what needs retesting for a change.

plugins.name: qa-knowledge-fabric
plugins.description: Ingestion, tagging, chunking, redaction and retrieval quality auditing for the shared RAG knowledge store.

plugins.name: qa-rag-augmented-authoring
plugins.description: Grounding contract, retrieval quality bar and citation reporting for artefacts written from organisational knowledge.

plugins.name: qa-test-case-design
plugins.description: Equivalence partitioning, boundary values, decision tables, state transition, pairwise, negative and permission testing, level assignment and traceability.

plugins.name: qa-synthetic-test-data
plugins.description: Schema derivation, referential integrity, edge-case distribution, regulatory profiles and lineage. No production PII, ever.

plugins.name: qa-playwright-automation
plugins.description: Operating rules, framework architecture, locator strategy, script generation and the Playwright MCP browser loop.

plugins.name: qa-failure-analysis
plugins.description: Failure triage, flake classification, locator drift repair and quarantine policy.

plugins.name: qa-script-maintenance
plugins.description: Suite health auditing, repair rules and test deletion criteria.

plugins.name: qa-cicd-integration
plugins.description: Stage design, quality gates, sharding, working GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and Jenkins pipelines, artefacts, secrets and debugging.

plugins.name: qa-shift-left-security
plugins.description: STRIDE threat modelling, security acceptance criteria, scanner triage and testing boundaries.

plugins.name: qa-performance-testing
plugins.description: Workload modelling, SLO definition, test type selection, bottleneck analysis and honest reporting.

plugins.name: qa-defect-reporting
plugins.description: Screening, report template, severity versus priority and root cause categories.

plugins.name: qa-test-metrics
plugins.description: Metric definitions, release readiness scoring, predictive defect scoring, reporting rules and dashboard specification.

plugins.name: qa-continuous-learning
plugins.description: Signal capture, learning validation, effectiveness tracking and loop failure modes.
